title: Restful, Chic East Nashville Getaway
description:
Find inspiration in this peaceful, modern, spacious condo in the vibrant, booming neighborhood of East Nashville. With space to work for the busy, games for the family, and comfort for those looking to retreat, you can’t go wrong with this.

Come stay in a condo just 7 miles from electric downtown Nashville, with so many dives, venues, and shops in between that you might never get there.

With 4 beds in 3 rooms, this condo can sleep up to 7 people comfortably. Come and bring the whole family!

The space
This is a peaceful space with 3 TVs, cable, 2 bedrooms with private full bathrooms, a washer and drier, full service kitchen, complementary Keurig with pods, a wide variety of games, and unlimited parking. It has everything you need just 7 miles from downtown and in the middle of the vibrant, diverse East Nashville!

Guest access
You will have unlimited access to the entire condo.
